title: RNA extraction for Karlodinium veneficum PLY720
author: Will Lewis

steps.title: Harvest and Prepare Cell Pellets
steps.instruction: Grow 200 ml of Karlodinium veneficum PLY720 culture in L1 medium and harvest when density is between 50,000 and 300,000 cells/ml.

substeps.instruction: Gently invert the culture flask several times to homogenise.
Transfer four 50 ml aliquots of the culture into four 50 ml centrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge the 50 ml tubes at 5000 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Decant and dispose of supernatants by pouring, leaving a small volume (~500 µl) on the walls to aid resuspension.
Resuspend the pellets using a pipette.
Pool the resuspended pellets using a 1000 µl pipette and transfer to a 2 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the microcentrifuge tube at 5000 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C and dispose of the supernatant using a 1000 µl pipette.
Flash-freeze the cell pellets by sealing the tubes and dropping them into a liquid N2 bath for several minutes.
Store pellets at -80 °C.

steps.title: Cell Lysis and Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells and separate the RNA using TRIzol and chloroform. Work in a fume hood whenever tubes are open.

substeps.instruction: Remove cell pellets from -80 °C and process immediately.
Resuspend each pellet in 1 ml TRIzol reagent using a 1 ml pipette; pipette up and down to homogenise.
Incubate the tube for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 200 µl chloroform to the tube and seal.
Gently shake to mix and incubate at room temperature for 2-3 minutes.
Centrifuge samples for 15 minutes at 12,000 x g at 4°C.
Carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a sterile RNase-free 1.5 ml tube using a 200 µl pipette, avoiding the DNA-containing interphase and not touching the tube sides.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation and Washing
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA and perform a series of ethanol washes to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 ml isopropanol to the aqueous phase and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C to form a white/gel-like pellet.
Remove and discard the supernatant using a 1 ml pipette.
Resuspend the pellet in 75% ethanol by pipetting up and down (do not vortex or pipette vigorously).
Centrifuge at 7500 x g at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant with a 1 ml pipette.
Repeat the resuspension in 75% ethanol and centrifugation steps at least two more times (total of three washes).

steps.title: RNA Drying and Rehydration
steps.instruction: Completely remove ethanol and resuspend the RNA pellet in distilled water.

substeps.instruction: Remove the majority of the final supernatant with a 1 ml pipette, then the remainder with a 10 µl pipette.
Briefly centrifuge to collect remaining liquid and remove with a 10 µl pipette; repeat once more to ensure the pellet is dry.
Immediately add 100 µl UltraPure™ DNase/RNase-Free Distilled Water to each sample and pipette gently to dislodge the pellet.
Place the tube in a heat block at 57 °C for 10 minutes.
Visually confirm dissolution; if necessary, pipette gently or incubate longer, or add another 50-100 µl of UltraPure™ DNase/RNase-Free Distilled Water.

steps.title: Storage and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Aliquot the samples and verify RNA quality and quantity.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot each sample into at least three tubes, label, and store at -80 °C.
Analyse samples using Nanodrop to ensure 260/280 ratio is ~2.0 and 260/230 ratio is between 2.0 and 2.2.
Measure RNA and DNA concentrations using Qubit BR assay kits.
